name: loop_view_axis
description: LP-4f1 and LP-4f2: a loop over the cube's faces, built on the Graph tab with Studio's controls only. The fixture carries the cube_capture feature, so the frame plan lists passes of the $capture/cube family with the face axis. Add loop puts a loop over a new, empty body in the root; its Loop fields' Over is set to View axis, and the family and the axis are chosen from what the frame plan lists ($capture/cube, face) -- nothing typed. Its count is the axis's length, read only (x6 (face)), and the zone's heading says so. With the zone picked, Add fullscreen pass puts a pass in the body, drawing into an image made at the size the cube's family draws at (LP-4f2: 256 x 256, six layers, read off the family's first raster pass's target -- the engine refuses a family whose passes draw at two sizes, render.view_family_extent_mismatch@1), in the loop's family. The pass's View field offers Each element (loop), which writes view_select face {$expr: element}. The engine expands the loop six times, one copy a face: the frame plan's copies run for faces 0 to 5, and the Frame Plan shows them as one group of six.
